A full example

The following code shows an example usage of the Timeline class.

// timeTest.cpp - Timeline test, ver. 1.00
//

#include "../lib/include/pandora.h"
#include <iostream>
#include <ctime>

using namespace std;

const int OPTIONS = 3;

class SinglOsc : public SoundEvent {
public:
    SinglOsc (SoundInfo* info, SignalTable* t0, double st, double dur) 
        : SoundEvent (info, st, dur) {
        m_osc = new LoopOscillator (info, t0);
        m_osc->frequency (t0->naturalFreq (info->samplingRate ()));
        
        m_env = new Envelope (info);
        m_env->gauss (1);
        m_env->mapTo (dur);
      }
    ~SinglOsc () {
        delete m_osc;
        delete m_env;
    }
    virtual SoundFrame& tick () {
        double d = m_env->tick () * m_osc->tick ();
        m_frame->set (Pandora::LEFT, d);
        m_frame->set (Pandora::RIGHT, d);    
        return *m_frame; 
    }
private:
    LoopOscillator* m_osc;
    Envelope* m_env;
    double m_pan;
};

class Filtest : public SoundEvent {
public:
    Filtest (SoundInfo* info, SignalTable* tab, double st, double dur, 
        double cutoff, double qual, Pandora::filterType ty) 
        : SoundEvent (info, st, dur) {
        
        m_osc = new LoopOscillator (info, tab);
        double f = tab->naturalFreq (info->samplingRate ());
        m_osc->frequency (f);
        
        m_filt = new VariState (info);
        m_filt->cutoff(cutoff);
        m_filt->type (ty);
        m_filt->quality (qual);
      }
    ~Filtest () {
        delete m_osc;
        delete m_filt;
    }
    virtual SoundFrame& tick () {
        double d = m_filt->process (m_osc->tick ());
        m_frame->set (Pandora::LEFT, d);
        m_frame->set (Pandora::RIGHT, d);    
        return *m_frame; 
    }
private:
    LoopOscillator* m_osc;
    VariState* m_filt;
};

int main (int argc, char* argv[]) {
    try {
        cout << "[timeTest, ver. 1.00 - timeline test]" << endl << endl 
             << "written by Carmine E. Cella, 2005" << endl
             << "based on the Pandora Audio Framework" << endl
             << "web: www.cryptosound.org" << endl << endl;
        
        if (argc != OPTIONS) {
            throw runtime_error ("syntax is: timeTest inputFile outputFile");
        }
                
        SoundInfo* info = SoundInfo::instance ();
        info->channels (2);
        
        cout << "sr: " << info->samplingRate () << endl;
        cout << "ch: " << info->channels () << endl << endl;
        
        cout << "setting up...";
        
        WavInFile* inFile;
        WavOutFile* outFile;
    
        inFile = new WavInFile (argv[1]);
        int bits = (inFile)->getNumBits ();
        double sampleRate = (inFile)->getSampleRate ();
        int channels = (inFile)->getNumChannels ();
        if (channels != 1 || sampleRate != 44100 || bits != 16) {
            throw runtime_error ("invalid input format");   
        }
        long p = inFile->getNumSamples ();
        
        outFile = new WavOutFile (argv[2], 44100, 16, 2);
        
        double tabDur = (double) p / info->samplingRate ();
        SignalTable t0 (p);
        long n = 0;
        
        while (!inFile->eof()) {
            short s;
            inFile->read (&s, sizeof (short));
            double d = (double) s;
            d /= 32768;
            t0.set (n, (double) d); 
            n++;              
        }

        SignalTable t1 (131072);
        t1.clear ();
        t1.gen (1, 1);

        Timeline time (info);
    
        SinglOsc* o = new SinglOsc (info, &t0, 0, tabDur);
        time.schedule (o);
        
        Filtest* f = new Filtest (info, &t0, tabDur + 1, tabDur, 110, 0.707, Pandora::LOWPASS);
        time.schedule (f);
        
        PeriodEstimator pdet (info);
        Harmonizer* harmon = new Harmonizer (info, &t0, &pdet, (2 * tabDur) + 2, tabDur);
        harmon->logic (Pandora::MINOR_SEVENTH);
        time.schedule (harmon);
        
        TableGranulator* tgran = new TableGranulator (info, &t1, (3 * tabDur) + 3, tabDur);
        tgran->density (80, 1);
        tgran->grainDuration ((double).08, .5);
        tgran->grainEnvelope (Pandora::HANNING);
        tgran->frequency (220, 1, 440, 1);
        tgran->grainAmplitude (.3);
        tgran->spatialPosition (1);  
        time.schedule (tgran);
         
        long samples = (long) (info->samplingRate () * time.duration ());
    
        short maxL = 0, maxR = 0;
        cout << "done\ncomputing data (16 bit shorts)...";
        clock_t start = clock ();
        for (long l = 0; l < samples; l++) {
            SoundFrame f;
            f = time.tick ();
            short sampLeft = (short) (f.get16bit (Pandora::LEFT));
            if (sampLeft > maxL)
                maxL = sampLeft;
            short sampRight = (short) (f.get16bit (Pandora::RIGHT));
            if (sampRight > maxR)
                maxR = sampRight;
            outFile->write ((void*) &sampLeft, sizeof (short));
            outFile->write ((void*) &sampRight, sizeof (short));
        }
        
        clock_t finish = clock ();
        double duration = (double)(finish - start) / CLOCKS_PER_SEC;
        cout << "done" << endl << "elapsed time: " 
            << duration << " sec." << endl << endl;
        cout << "max amplitudes: " << maxL << ", " << maxR << endl;
        cout << time.duration () << " sec. globally" << endl << endl;
        
        outFile->close ();
        inFile->close ();
        getchar ();
    }
    catch (runtime_error& e) {
        cout << "\nRuntime error: " << e.what () << endl;
        getchar ();
    }
    catch (exception& e) {
        cout << "\nGeneral exception: " << e.what () << endl;
        getchar ();
    }
    catch (...) {
        cout << "\nFatal error" << endl;
        getchar ();
    }
    return 0;
}

// EOF
